No open shelving is visible. The 11 books stand on the desk. The almirah probably has internal shelves, but it was not opened.

Electrical risk: the old wooden switchboard has scorch marks around the 3-pin socket. Nearby wiring is loose surface cable with taped joints, and the Havells MCB enclosure is marked 2014. Recommend an electrician's inspection. This bears on fire-claim underwriting.
The wall-mounted fibre router looks ISP-supplied and is probably ISP-owned, so it may need to be excluded.
The Carrier AC still has its protective film on and looks newly installed. Ask for the invoice (model and tonnage not visible). The outdoor unit was not photographed.
Laptop and monitor exact models were not readable. The laptop is priced as a Victus 15 Ryzen 5 with RTX 3050 and 8GB RAM. An invoice could move RCV by about Rs 20,000.
